A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KV-cache management survey and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables and references for reliable comparison. Neither contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: v1 compiles published methods, qualitative method comparisons and dataset descriptions. Performance statements are attributed to cited work; no original empirical results from this survey are reported.

after.justification: v3 remains a literature survey. Newly discussed findings are attributed to cited papers, and the added figures are explanatory schematics rather than original experimental results.

M1.justification: Neither version proposes an algorithm or model. v3 expands and corrects descriptions of existing methods while retaining the token-level, model-level and system-level taxonomy.

E1.justification: Section 7 changes the surveyed benchmark catalog, including discussion of MultiTurnBench, NumericBench, RULER and OneRuler. These benchmarks are described, not used in training or evaluation conducted by this survey.

E2.justification: The expanded comparison tables classify properties of published methods. Neither version experimentally evaluates baseline methods against a proposed method, so additional surveyed approaches do not constitute baseline changes.

E3.justification: Neither version presents an experimental evaluation protocol for this work. Section 7 condenses benchmark and metric documentation, without establishing changes to actual experiments or their settings.

E4.justification: No ablation, sensitivity test, robustness experiment or case-study analysis is added or revised. The new figures illustrate concepts, and production case studies are suggested as future work.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. v3 introduces no statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: v3 adds cited qualitative findings, including L2Compress's association between lower key-embedding L2 norms and higher attention scores (Section 4.1.1), and DMS's accuracy advantage over training-free sparse attention (Section 6.1.1). These are newly summarized third-party findings, not original experiments or same-setting performance improvements; retained numerical claims such as CLA's 2x cache reduction remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 11 corrects KV-cache space complexity by replacing the factor 2 with d_k + d_v. Section 4.4 also corrects exponential cache growth to linear growth. These are limited mathematical corrections; the remaining formal exposition is largely retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central contribution: a comprehensive three-level taxonomy and comparative survey of KV-cache management, accompanied by benchmark coverage. Stronger descriptive adjectives do not materially change this claim.

C2.justification: The conclusion adds specific discussion of difficulties evaluating cross-category combinations, production case studies, domain-specific requirements, privacy-aware eviction and tenant isolation. Section 7 also adds a qualification about future training contamination affecting LooGLE's zero-shot evaluation. Most existing limitations remain, sometimes condensed.

D1.justification: Detailed benchmark preparation and usage documentation is substantially reduced. v1 specifies, for example, StreamingEval's query spacing and M4LE's News2016 length filtering; v3 omits these and most dataset source, instance-count, length and metric metadata from the former Tables 13–19. The curated-paper repository link remains unchanged. This is a loss of documentation, not evidence of changed experiments.

R1.justification: Literature coverage expands substantially across token and system optimization, adding discussions such as L2Compress, Q-Filters, Loki, ResQ, eLLM, Apt-Serve, FlowKV and HeadInfer. Benchmark coverage is also revised, while numerous individual-dataset references disappear. The overall three-level research positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Section 7 is reorganized from a detailed task-by-task dataset catalog into benchmark summaries and a unified metrics subsection. Several future-direction passages are condensed, the SVD discussion is rewritten, and detailed GQA-extension prose is removed while those methods remain in the taxonomy and comparison table.

P2.justification: v3 adds four schematics covering attention sparsity, quantization, MHA/MQA/GQA and server architecture (Figures 4, 5, 8 and 9). Taxonomies and method tables gain entries, while v1 Tables 13–19 are replaced by two substantially different benchmark task-and-language matrices.

improvement.justification: v3 improves technical accuracy through the cache-space formula and linear-growth corrections, clarifies low-rank methods, and makes the survey more current and accessible through expanded literature coverage and explanatory figures. These benefits are tempered by substantial loss of dataset preparation/statistics documentation and some detailed method explanations. The net improvement is modest rather than a major strengthening of the paper.
